title: Savory Masarepa Stuffed Quesadilla
description: A unique German-inspired quesadilla filled with savory masarepa and salty Venezuelan ingredients.
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
In a large bowl, mix together masarepa, crumbled salty cheese, and grated yellow cheese.
Add sliced Venezuelan chorizo to the bowl and mix well.
Place a quesadilla on a flat surface and spoon the masarepa mixture onto half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
Cook the quesadilla in the preheated skillet for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
Cut the quesadilla into wedges and serve hot.
